# Smart Home Improvements

> Licensed California home improvement contractor (CSLB #1129883) serving
> Fresno and the Central Valley since 2014. Three services under one roof:
> roofing (repair and replacement), replacement windows (Anlin dealer;
> Anlin windows are manufactured in Clovis, CA), and insulation
> (attic insulation and radiant barrier).

## Key facts

- Business: Smart Home Improvements (service-area business, no storefront)
- Phone: (559) 833-6945
- Email: info@smarthomeimprove.com
- License: California CSLB #1129883 (verify at cslb.ca.gov)
- Service area: Fresno, Clovis, Madera, and Visalia, CA, plus surrounding
  Central Valley communities
- Hours: Mon-Fri 9am-7pm, Sat 9am-6pm, closed Sunday
- Google rating: 4.9 stars (54 reviews)
- Offers: free 21-Point Roof Inspection, free Window & Energy Assessment,
  free Home Comfort & Energy Assessment (insulation). All no-obligation.
- Instant pricing: smarthomeimprove.com/estimate/ shows an honest Fresno
  price range for windows or a roof in 60 seconds, before any contact info.
- Windows brand: Anlin (double lifetime transferable warranty), built in
  Clovis, CA, about 15 minutes from our office.
- Climate context: California Climate Zone 13 (Title 24 cool-roof and
  window efficiency requirements apply to our work).
- Hablamos espanol: smarthomeimprove.com/es/
